name: javdbviewed
description: JavdBviewed monorepo — browser extension + shared sync packages

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @javdb/sync-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @javdb/sync-client typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:regression && pnpm run test:extension
scripts.test:style-contract: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.cjs apps/extension/src/ui/tokens/themeTokens.test.ts scripts/assert-css-isolation.test.ts apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Button/Button.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Input/Input.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Toggle/Toggle.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Modal/Modal.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/MediaCover/MediaCover.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Card/Card.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Tabs/Tabs.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/primitives/Toast/Toast.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/PageHeader/PageHeader.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/EmptyState/EmptyState.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/FilterChip/FilterChip.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/SettingSection/SettingSection.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/SettingToggleRow/SettingToggleRow.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/SettingField/SettingField.test.tsx apps/extension/src/ui/patterns/SettingSelect/SettingSelect.test.tsx && node scripts/assert-css-isolation.cjs
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --config vitest.config.cjs --coverage && vitest run --config vitest.dom.config.cjs --coverage && vitest run --config vitest.extension.config.cjs --coverage
scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:dom && pnpm run test:style-contract && pnpm run build
scripts.test:extension:e2e: pnpm run build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.ts
